run_challenge_eval: run the challenge evaluation script with a model name and NPZ results file to compute success rate
test_is_successful: test the is_successful function to check if predicted energy is within threshold of DFT energy
compute_valid_ml_success: compute validated ML success rates by comparing ML energies against DFT ground truth energies
process_ml_data: process ML prediction results from an NPZ file and map energies to system and config IDs
get_dft_data: get organized DFT target data as a nested dictionary mapping system IDs to config energies
